subject: Television & Streaming
title: FAST Channels: Free Streaming's Rise
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on FAST Channels: Free Streaming's Rise.

hook.text: FAST stands for Free Ad-Supported Streaming Television. Platforms like Tubi and Pluto TV offer free content with ads.

buildup.text: FAST channels replicate the old broadcast experience: lean back, flip through channels, and watch whatever is on.

discovery.text: Tubi reaches over 70 million monthly active users.

twist.text: FAST channels are growing faster than paid streaming.

climax.text: FAST represents a return to television's origins: free content funded by advertising.

punchline.text: Free TV died. Then free TV came back.

quiz.question: What does FAST stand for in streaming television?
